criteria.observable: On CB6 with the target APK and installed map, representative shop=convenience features are acquired from local MWM data.
Known convenience stores visibly use the correct CB6 brand icon; unknown stores use the generic CB6 convenience icon.
CB6 brand icons remain visible while stock CoMaps convenience icon and convenience-store name clutter are absent from map presentation.
Convenience POIs remain available with network unavailable, using installed MWM data.
Non-convenience POIs and the existing signal presentation remain operational after the convenience presentation change.
